edits.porch_empty: Keep the same thick-black-outline flat cartoon art style as the reference: white round heads, big expressive eyes. The same porch and front door of the yellow house. Nobody on the porch now: the brown cardboard box dropped on its side on the floor, one white sneaker left behind, a cartoon dust-cloud trail leading off the porch toward a green hedge in the yard. No people. Vertical, no text.
